videos.title: Discovering: Richard Dreyfuss
videos.description: A glimpse into the life and career of the Oscar-winning Hollywood actor who starred in The Goodbye Girl, Jaws and Down and Out in Beverly Hills.

videos.title: Discovering: Basil Rathbone
videos.description: A profile of the English star of stage and screen, who appeared as the villainous Guy of Gisborne in The Adventures of Robin Hood and played Sherlock Holmes in 14 films.

videos.title: Money Electric: The Bitcoin Mystery
videos.description: Documentary exploring the origins of cryptocurrency Bitcoin and the identity of its pseudonymous creator Satoshi Nakamoto.

videos.title: After the Bite
videos.description: Documentary investigating the surge in great white sharks patrolling Cape Cod's shallow waters and the fallout from one young man's death.

videos.title: My Icon: Nasser Hussain
videos.description: The former England cricket captain and Sky Sports pundit discusses the individuals that have inspired him during his life and career.

videos.title: Luca: Seeing Red
videos.description: Chris Harris travels to Italy to spends a week with Italian businessman Luca di Montezemolo, the former chairman of Ferrari.

videos.title: Villeneuve Pironi: Racing's Untold Tragedy
videos.description: The relationship between F1 drivers Gilles Villeneuve and Didier Pironi, team-mates whose friendship was torn apart after a controversial ending to the 1982 San Marino Grand Prix.

videos.title: Williams & Mansell: Red 5
videos.description: Documentary charting the rise of Nigel Mansell, the Williams F1 racing team and how they came together to fight for the Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship.

videos.title: My Icon: Martin Offiah
videos.description: The former rugby league superstar discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career.

videos.title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
videos.description: The story of Allen Stanford's plan to revolutionise the game of cricket, which fell apart when he was exposed as a financial fraudster.

videos.title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
videos.description: Now bankrupt, Allen Stanford spies a new opportunity in Montserrat. However, his new venture attracts the attention of US and UK law enforcement agencies.

videos.title: The Man Who Bought Cricket
videos.description: Allen Stanford moves his operation to Antigua where he discovers the power of cricket in the Caribbean.

videos.title: The Battle for Blackpool
videos.description: The story of how a clan of fiercely loyal Blackpool FC fans staged the largest football boycott in British history and managed to win their club back.

videos.title: QPR: The Four Year Plan
videos.description: An insight into the running of Queens Park Rangers football club, as cameras were given unprecedented access to the boardroom and the first team. In 2007, the club was facing relegation from the Championship as well as financial ruin, before being bought by F1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone and Italian businessman Flavio Briatore. Soon after, they were joined on the board by Indian steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, and together the new owners promised a return to glory for the club and its supporters.

videos.title: King of Lies: Football's Greatest Con
videos.description: A look at fraudster Russell King's takeover of Notts County, which set in motion a chain of events that exposed a web of deception at the heart of the project, with lasting personal and financial consequences for those involved.

videos.title: Brazil 2002
videos.description: Documentary following the Brazilian national team through the 2002 World Cup, which culminated in the country's fifth victory in the tournament.

videos.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
videos.description: Rare performances, interviews and rarely seen footage come together to paint a picture of the history and origins of the Motown record label.

videos.title: Discovering: Jon Voight
videos.description: A look at the life and career of the actor, who starred in Midnight Cowboy, Deliverance and Runaway Train and won an Academy Award for his role in 1978 film Coming Home.

videos.title: Discovering: Dustin Hoffman
videos.description: A look at the life and career of the actor, who starred in The Graduate, Midnight Cowboy and Tootsie and won Academy Awards for his roles in Kramer vs Kramer and Rain Man.

videos.title: Bardot
videos.description: A look at the life and career of actress Brigitte Bardot, examining the hardships, trials and struggles she faced as well as her work and legacy.

videos.title: Premier League 360 - Big Sam's Bolton
videos.description: A look at Sam Allardyce's Bolton Wanderers team, with the manager using pioneering sports science and data analysis to take the club on an unforgettable journey.

videos.title: The Battle for Blackpool
videos.description: The story of how a clan of fiercely loyal Blackpool FC fans staged the largest football boycott in British history and managed to win their club back.

videos.title: I Am Steve McQueen
videos.description: The life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Thomas Crown Affair, The Getaway, Papillon, The Magnificent Seven, The Great Escape and The Towering Inferno. Featuring contributions by his son Chad, grandson Steven and granddaughter Molly, as well as ex-wives Neile Adams McQueen and Ali MacGraw and widow Barbara Minty McQueen.

videos.title: I'm Carl Lewis!
videos.description: A profile of the former athlete, who was a nine-time Olympic gold medalist and fought to revolutionise his sport and inspire change on and off the field.

videos.title: Lancaster
videos.description: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

videos.title: Spitfire
videos.description: The story of the British single-seat fighter plane the Supermarine Spitfire, designed by RJ Mitchell and famous for its role in the Battle of Britain. Archive footage, new film of the aircraft in flight and interviews with the last surviving veterans who flew the plane in combat combine to tell its story.

videos.title: The Alabama Solution
videos.description: Documentary film about the prison system in Alabama told from the perspective of incarcerated inmates, who reveal endemic abuse of power and a cover-up.

videos.title: Bowling for Columbine
videos.description: Michael Moore's Oscar-winning documentary exploring America's love affair with firearms. Going beyond public opinion, the film-maker examines corporate and political influence, visiting a bank where weapons are given to customers, as well as talking to Charlton Heston, one of the most famous proponents of every American's right to bear arms.

videos.title: Mr Dynamite: The Rise of James Brown
videos.description: The career of the singer, musician and producer, charting his journey from his first hit Please, Please, Please in 1956 through his pioneering funk phase to later chart success.

videos.title: Adam Hills: Foot Fault
videos.description: The comedian and host of The Last Leg takes viewers behind the scenes of a global campaign to promote para-standing tennis and its potential as a future Grand Slam and Paralympic event. Adam meets and plays with former Grand Slam winners and uncovers the barriers faced by aspiring tennis players with disabilities who want to be included by their sport at the highest level.

videos.title: The Directors
videos.description: A look at the career of English director Stephen Frears, whose films include My Beautiful Laundrette, Dangerous Liaisons, The Grifters, High Fidelity, The Queen and Philomena.

videos.title: 100 Foot Wave
videos.description: In Nazaré, Portugal, an unprecedented swell from Hurricane Epsilon kicks the 2020 big-wave surfing season into high gear.

videos.title: Discovering: Julia Roberts
videos.description: A look at the life and career of the actress, who starred in Pretty Woman, The Pelican Brief, Ocean's Eleven and Notting Hill and won an Oscar for her role in Erin Brockovich.

videos.title: The Directors
videos.description: The life and work of Steven Spielberg, whose films include Jaws, ET the Extra-Terrestrial, Raiders of the Lost Ark and Jurassic Park and who won Oscars for directing Schindler's List and Saving Private Ryan.

videos.title: The Movies
videos.description: A look at the history of cinema through the 1970s, including films that pushed the boundaries of filmmaking from The Godfather to Jaws.

videos.title: The Comedy Store
videos.description: The Comedy Store's founding generation in the 1970s launched the careers of Freddie Prinze, Richard Pryor, David Letterman and Jay Leno.

videos.title: Spector
videos.description: Documentary about music producer Phil Spector, looking at his life and career and the events that led to him shooting Lana Clarkson dead in 2003.

videos.title: Lance
videos.description: Part one of two. A personal examination of the rise and fall of Lance Armstrong. The programme examines the young Texan cyclist's rise to fame, his struggle with testicular cancer and subsequent emergence as a global icon with seven consecutive Tour de France titles, and his eventual downfall when he was revealed as being at the centre of one of the biggest doping scandals in sporting history.

videos.title: Lance
videos.description: Part two of two. A personal examination of the rise and fall of Lance Armstrong. The series examines the young Texan cyclist's rise to fame, his struggle with testicular cancer and subsequent emergence as a global icon with seven consecutive Tour de France titles, and his eventual downfall when he was revealed as being at the centre of one of the biggest doping scandals in sporting history.

videos.title: The Directors
videos.description: The life and work of Steven Spielberg, whose films include Jaws, ET the Extra-Terrestrial, Raiders of the Lost Ark and Jurassic Park and who won Oscars for directing Schindler's List and Saving Private Ryan.

videos.title: Discovering: Julia Roberts
videos.description: A look at the life and career of the actress, who starred in Pretty Woman, The Pelican Brief, Ocean's Eleven and Notting Hill and won an Oscar for her role in Erin Brockovich.

videos.title: The Movies
videos.description: A look at the history of cinema through the 1970s, including films that pushed the boundaries of filmmaking from The Godfather to Jaws.

videos.title: The Comedy Store
videos.description: The Comedy Store's founding generation in the 1970s launched the careers of Freddie Prinze, Richard Pryor, David Letterman and Jay Leno.

videos.title: Death on the Beach
videos.description: In 2015 Chrissie Annesley travelled to the paradise island of Koh Tao for the trip of a lifetime. Two weeks later she was found dead in her beach hut, the latest in a tragic roll call of young travellers to have died under mysterious circumstances on this most remote of Thailand's islands. This documentary asks whether Chrissie and the others were victims of misadventure or part of a series of violent murders.

videos.title: Death on the Beach
videos.description: After tracking down the last man to see his daughter alive, Boyne Annesley learns that shortly before her death Chrissie was asking questions about the double murders of Hannah Witheridge and David Miller on the island's Sairee Beach in 2014.

videos.title: Death on the Beach
videos.description: Boyne Annesley follows up leads that he hopes will prove what happened to his daughter Chrissie, and meets MP Hannah Bardell to campaign for more Foreign Office support after suspicious deaths.

videos.title: Germanwings: What Happened on Flight 9525?
videos.description: The circumstances surrounding the crash of an Airbus A320-211 in 2015, which killed 150 people and was found to have been deliberately caused by the co-pilot.
